commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Attach the Mockito agent explicitly instead of self-attaching

On Java 21 the test run warns that Mockito is self-attaching a Java agent to
its own JVM, which a future JDK release will refuse. Nothing here uses
Mockito; its inline mock maker arrives through spring-boot-starter-test and is
loaded by the Spring Boot test listeners.

Following Mockito's own recommendation, maven-dependency-plugin exposes the
mockito-core jar path and surefire passes it as -javaagent. The empty
<argLine/> property is required: surefire replaces @{argLine} late, and
without a definition the placeholder reaches the JVM verbatim and startup
fails.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Upgrade to Spring Boot 4.1.1 on Java 21

The 3.x line went open-source end of life on 2026-06-30. 4.1.1 is the current
active line; it brings Spring Framework 7 and Spring Integration 7.1, requires
Java 17 as a minimum, and is compatible up to Java 26. Java 21 is the current
LTS release and is what the build now targets.

Spring Integration 7.1 splits the ip.tcp package by direction, so
TcpOutboundGateway moves to ip.tcp.outbound. The connection factories in
ip.tcp.connection are unchanged. README now points at the jdk17 branch for the
3.5.x line.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Add a TCP round-trip integration test

Only the context load was covered, so nothing verified the part that is
actually easy to get wrong: the CRLF framing on the wire and the request/reply
correlation through the pooled connection. A regression there would have
compiled and started up fine.

TcpClientIntegrationTests runs a stub server on an OS-assigned port so the
suite is independent of anything listening locally, and drives a plain
ServerSocket so the framing is visible in the test itself. The second case
answers two requests on one accepted connection, which only works if the
caching factory hands the connection back to the pool.

The scheduled job would otherwise send its own messages into that stub, so it
becomes conditional on tcp.client.scheduler.enabled. It stays on by default;
the tests switch it off, which also keeps the context load test from logging
connection failures.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.5.16 on Java 17

The 3.x line is the successor to 2.7 and requires Java 17 as a minimum.
3.5.16 is its last open-source patch.

No source changes were needed: the project uses no javax.* APIs, so the
jakarta.* namespace change does not reach it, and the Spring Integration IP
classes it relies on are unchanged in 6.5.x. README now points at the jdk8
branch for the Java 8 line.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Rewrite README with build, run, and protocol details

The README said what the project was for and nothing about how to use it.
The CRLF framing in particular is invisible in the source — it comes from the
default serializer on the connection factory — and is the first thing that
breaks when the client is pointed at a server that does not use it.

Documents requirements, build and run commands, the wire protocol with a
PowerShell listener to try it against, the configuration properties with
their defaults, and how the beans fit together.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Upgrade Maven wrapper to 3.9.16

The wrapper pinned Maven 3.5.4 from 2018, which cannot build recent Spring
Boot releases. Regenerated with wrapper:wrapper at 3.9.16, the current 3.x
release.

The distribution type is only-script, so the wrapper script downloads the
Maven distribution itself and the committed maven-wrapper.jar binary is no
longer needed in the repository.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Upgrade to Spring Boot 2.7.18

1.5.15.RELEASE reached end of life in 2019 and its dependencies no longer
receive security fixes. 2.7.18 is the last open-source patch of the 2.x line
and the last one that still supports Java 8, so it is the largest step that
can be taken without also changing the JDK.

From Spring Boot 2.4 onwards spring-boot-starter-test no longer ships the
JUnit vintage engine, so the context load test moves to JUnit 5: the
@RunWith(SpringRunner.class) runner is dropped and org.junit.Test becomes
org.junit.jupiter.api.Test.
